hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, for example astrocytes, APOE4 causes impaired ARF6-related recycling of receptors between the cell surface and the endosome, compared with APOE3.

paper.title: ApoE4 Alters ABCA1 Membrane Trafficking in Astrocytes.
paper.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience

findings.finding_description: Cell-surface biotinylation of primary astrocytes from ApoE3- and ApoE4-TR neonatal mice showed significantly lower plasma-membrane ABCA1 in ApoE4 astrocytes. Membrane level is used as a readout of recycling; recycling itself was not measured.
findings.quote: However, membrane ABCA1 levels were significantly lower in ApoE4 primary astrocytes compared with ApoE3 (Fig. 1D, top, and F).
findings.summary: ApoE4 primary astrocytes have less surface ABCA1 than ApoE3 astrocytes.

findings.finding_description: Western blot of primary astrocytes showed higher ARF6 protein in ApoE4-TR than in ApoE3-TR astrocytes. This links ApoE4 to the ARF6 pathway, but it is a protein-level measurement, not a measurement of ARF6 activity or of recycling.
findings.quote: We found greater protein levels of ARF6 in ApoE4 primary astrocytes compared with ApoE3 primary astrocytes (Fig. 1H,I).
findings.summary: ApoE4 astrocytes express more ARF6 protein than ApoE3 astrocytes.

findings.finding_description: HeLa cells expressing ABCA1-GFP were treated with recombinant ApoE3 or ApoE4 for 30 min. With rApoE4, ABCA1 colocalized more with LAMP2 (late endosome/lysosome) and less with Rab11 (recycling endosome). These are non-brain cells given exogenous protein, and colocalization serves as a proxy for recycling.
findings.quote: Greater colocalization of ABCA1 with the late endosome marker LAMP2 and lower colocalization with the recycling endosome marker Rab11 were observed in cells treated with rApoE4 compared with rApoE3 (Fig. 2).
findings.summary: rApoE4 shifts ABCA1 from Rab11 recycling endosomes toward LAMP2 compartments in HeLa cells.
findings.experimental_system: HeLa cells stably expressing ABCA1-GFP treated with recombinant ApoE3/ApoE4

findings.finding_description: ARF6 siRNA in ApoE4 primary astrocytes reduced ARF6 protein and significantly increased cholesterol efflux at 4 h and 24 h. This supports ARF6 involvement in the ApoE4 phenotype, but there was no ApoE3 comparison and efflux is only a proxy for ABCA1 recycling.
findings.quote: Knockdown of ARF6 by siRNA resulted in significant increase in cholesterol efflux in ApoE4 primary astrocytes after 4 and 24 h (Fig. 3C–E).
findings.summary: ARF6 knockdown boosts cholesterol efflux in ApoE4 astrocytes.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE4-TR mouse primary astrocytes, ARF6 siRNA

findings.finding_description: In primary astrocytes, ABCA1 mRNA and total protein did not differ between ApoE3 and ApoE4. This null result argues that the lower surface ABCA1 reflects altered trafficking rather than altered expression.
findings.quote: ABCA1 mRNA and total protein levels did not differ between ApoE3 and ApoE4 primary astrocytes (Fig. 1D, bottom, and G).
findings.summary: No ApoE genotype difference in total ABCA1 in primary astrocytes.

findings.finding_description: ApoE4 primary astrocytes showed lower cholesterol efflux than ApoE3 astrocytes at 4 h and 24 h. Efflux is a functional surrogate for surface ABCA1 recycling.
findings.quote: As expected, lower plasma membrane ABCA1 expression and recycling observed in ApoE4 primary astrocytes were associated with lower cholesterol efflux at 4 h (Fig. 3A) and 24 h (Fig. 3B) compared with that of ApoE3.
findings.summary: ApoE4 astrocytes efflux less cholesterol than ApoE3 astrocytes.

findings.finding_description: In immortalized ApoE4 astrocytes, ABCA1 mRNA and total protein were lower than in ApoE3 astrocytes. This differs from primary astrocytes and points to an expression-level rather than trafficking difference in this system, a potential confound for the hypothesis.
findings.quote: The results showed ABCA1 mRNA and protein were significantly decreased in ApoE4 immortalized astrocytes compared with ApoE3 (Fig. 1A–C).
findings.summary: Immortalized ApoE4 astrocytes have lower ABCA1 expression, not just trafficking changes.
findings.experimental_system: immortalized astrocytes from human ApoE3/ApoE4 knock-in mice

findings.finding_description: Treating ApoE4 primary astrocytes with the ABCA1 agonist CS-6253 increased membrane ABCA1 and decreased total ARF6 protein. This links ARF6 levels to surface ABCA1, but drug effects may act through other routes.
findings.quote: CS-6253 increased the relative amount of ABCA1 on plasma membrane and significantly decreased total ARF6 protein expression in ApoE4-treated cells (Fig. 5A–C).
findings.summary: CS-6253 raises surface ABCA1 and lowers ARF6 in ApoE4 astrocytes.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE4-TR mouse primary astrocytes treated with CS-6253

findings.finding_description: ARF6 knockdown combined with CS-6253 produced only a small further increase in efflux in ApoE4 astrocytes. The authors conclude the CS-6253 effect on ABCA1 recycling is not entirely ARF6-dependent, which partially qualifies an ARF6-exclusive mechanism.
findings.quote: ApoE4 primary astrocytes had a small but significant increase in cholesterol efflux after reducing ARF6 protein and the addition of CS-6253 (Fig. 7B). The effects of CS-6253 on ABCA1 recycling were therefore not completely dependent on lowering of ARF6.
findings.summary: Efflux rescue in ApoE4 astrocytes is only partly ARF6-dependent.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE4-TR mouse primary astrocytes, ARF6 siRNA plus CS-6253

findings.finding_description: In HeLa ABCA1-GFP cells treated with rApoE4, adding CS-6253 increased ABCA1-Rab11 colocalization by 11%. This shows the rApoE4-associated recycling-endosome deficit is reversible; non-brain cells were used.
findings.quote: Compared with cells treated with rApoE4 only, ABCA1 colocalization with Rab11 significantly increased by 11% upon cotreating cells with rApoE4 plus CS-6253 and by 12% with CS-6253 alone (Fig. 6A,B).
findings.summary: CS-6253 restores ABCA1-Rab11 colocalization under rApoE4.
findings.experimental_system: HeLa cells expressing ABCA1-GFP treated with recombinant ApoE4 ± CS-6253

findings.finding_description: In ABCA1-induced BHK cells, rApoE4 produced lower cholesterol efflux than rApoE3. These are non-brain cells and efflux is only a surrogate for recycling.
findings.quote: rApoE4-treated cells exhibited significantly lower cholesterol efflux compared with cells treated with rApoE3 (Fig. 3F).
findings.summary: rApoE4 supports less ABCA1-mediated efflux than rApoE3 in BHK cells.
findings.experimental_system: mifepristone-induced ABCA1-expressing BHK cells with recombinant ApoE3/ApoE4

findings.finding_description: The GnHCl-soluble (aggregated) fraction of ABCA1 and ApoE was increased in ApoE4 vs ApoE3 primary astrocytes. The authors propose this aggregation as a mechanism trapping ABCA1 intracellularly; recycling was not measured.
findings.quote: The relative amount of aggregated ABCA1 and ApoE were significantly increased in ApoE4 primary astrocytes compared with ApoE3 primary astrocytes (Fig. 4D,E).
findings.summary: More aggregated ABCA1 in ApoE4 astrocytes.
